scope: Isolated emitted native/full grain, bitmap and chromatic scenes, desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2, CPU1/4. Eight-second interrupted input stories record actual scheduler RAF intervals, long tasks, FCP/readiness and CDP layout/paint/frame traces. All original source render caps remain intact; scheduler FPS does not imply a different source render cadence. Fonts are prepared before mounting. No model snapshots or pixel readbacks occur per frame. Physical input is verified separately. Measurements exclude public route/module transfer and leave final timing gates open.

checkoutLineEndings.policy: Measured source hashes bind actual checkout bytes. Only these unchanged UTF-8 files differ from their Git blobs by CRLF to LF normalization. Every new or changed payload must match the Git index exactly before publication.
